title: Fix the Substring Bounds
description: The program should extract the first three characters of a word.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 'Jav', the first three characters of 'Java'.
actualProblem: substring(0, 4) is called intending to get 3 characters, but the end index 4 makes it return all 4 characters of 'Java' instead of the intended 3.
explanation: String.substring(begin, end) includes begin but excludes end, similar to array/list slicing. To get exactly 3 characters starting at index 0, the end index must be 3, not 4.
